title: Stop Saying "Very Hard"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very hard". Use one of these words instead:
• Tough: It's a tough climb
• Tricky: Every step is tricky
• Brutal: What a brutal climb!

Comment your own word for "very hard"!
